quests.text: Take down 8 Thistlefur Avengers and 8 Thistlefur Shaman; most are located east of Zoram Strand in Thistlefur Village. Once completed, return to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

objectives.text: Scout the gazebo on Mystral Lake that overlooks the nearby Alliance outpost.
